_meta.description: UI layer (cutRsc/titleRsc/...) and map facts. Every entry carries a provenance tag (wiki, wiki-note, community, inferred, heuristic).
could_not_read: https://community.bistudio.com/wiki/RscTitles / Description.ext (RscTitles properties): the fetch tool returned nothing for these, so no RscTitles property rules exist
https://community.bistudio.com/wiki/Arma_3:_GUI_Coordinates (safeZone formulas): not readable, so no control-geometry rules exist

source_conflicts.topic: map control inside a controls group (MAPUI007)
source_conflicts.wiki: CT_MAP_MAIN page: the map control cannot be placed inside a CT_CONTROLS_GROUP
source_conflicts.shipped_code: ACE3 (fcs, laser, javelin, spike) defines ACE_Rangehelper / ACE_LaserCode_Helper: RscMapControl inside CA_IGUI_elements_group of RscInGameUI as invisible helper controls that only run onDraw

source_conflicts.wiki: cutRsc documents cutRsc ["Default", ...] as the way to remove a resource; the titleRsc page says the class no longer exists as of 2.12
source_conflicts.decision: reported as info with the cutText ["", "PLAIN"] / cutFadeOut alternative

source_conflicts.community: one forum post links a 4-character format on Zoom0 to a crash; the PMC tutorial uses 4 digits on Zoom1 without a crash

notes.PLAIN: centred text, fades in and out
notes.PLAIN DOWN: text aligned 25% up from the bottom of the screen
notes.BLACK OUT: whole screen black, shows the element, hides the other GUI behind the curtain
notes.BLACK FADED: black without a fade-in; with no speed it disappears after ~5-10 s, with a speed the screen stays black
notes.WHITE OUT: whole screen white; can blind the player, always set a fade-in time

known_vanilla_ui_classes._note: RscTitles / CfgTitles classes that ship with the game. Minimal on purpose: only names with evidence (CBA_A3 uses cutRsc RscTitleDisplayEmpty). Extend with --vanilla-classes.

map_grid._formula: posX = offsetX + stepX*gridX ; posY = mapSize - offsetY - stepY*gridY   (BIS_fnc_gridToPos as posted by Moricky and Killzone_Kid)
map_grid._conventions: offsetX 0, offsetY = mapSize, negative stepY; zoom classes finest first with ascending zoomMax; one digit fewer per x10 step

map_preview._note: Heuristic thresholds for the offline map preview. Not BI limits.

satellite_swatches._note: Stand-ins for the satellite texture, which depends on the terrain. Dark forest/dusk-like and bright sand-like.

default_style._note: Values of the default RscMapControl class as dumped in a community gist; used only to fill properties a mod does not set.
